system.description: Knowing the target's mortal birth name, sketch his face in your own blood on unblemished paper (Static Physical Challenge against his Social Traits, retest with an appropriate Crafts Ability), write his birth name across the forehead in black ink, and cut the image's throat with a silver dagger. For the rest of the night, the subject loses all Fortitude-granted Physical Traits except Endurance, with generation-based exceptions for elders of seventh generation or higher.
